public_seam: Apex FactorResearchBenchmarkService publishes and reads benchmark facts through WorkspaceClient; generated factor execution crosses only the strict quant-runtime benchmark-exec transport CLI.
identity_impact: Benchmark suite, upstream task attribution, synthetic dataset, researcher model/prompt/adapter/environment, scoring, sample seeds, sandbox capability/image/entrypoint/limits, and budget limits are immutable benchmark identities. Transport paths, timestamps, container IDs, and host details are excluded.
evidence_level: Benchmark records are external researcher-quality observations only. They are not campaign execution, Candidate gate, Strategy Package, Runtime formal evidence, Evidence v2, qualification, reporting, or production approval.
fail_closed_behavior: Unknown or drifted upstream, task, data, researcher, scoring, sandbox, budget, artifact, or denominator identities fail before spend or execution. The all_declared_samples rule keeps partial, failed, skipped, blocked, and unavailable samples in coverage denominators. Production-enabled execution requires the attested SPEC-005 OCI path; no fallback runner, data source, backtester, ledger, registry, or evidence truth is allowed.
